tables.title: RDES0 normal descriptor (write-back format)
tables.text_helper: Table 837, "RDES0 normal descriptor (write-back format)", in section 76.10.4 (Receive descriptor) on page 4167. Columns: Bit, Name, Description. 2 data row(s).

rows:
Inner VLAN Tag
This field contains the Inner VLAN tag of the received 
packet if the RS0V bit of RDES3 is set. This is valid only 
when Double VLAN tag processing and VLAN tag stripping 
are enabled.

Outer VLAN Tag
This field contains the Outer VLAN tag of the received 
packet if the RS0V bit of RDES3 is set.
